root_cause.evidence: The patch moves `old_wi_state = rcu_dereference_protected(wi_state, ...)` before the `if (!input)` check and adds `kfree(new_wi_state);` on the early return path; the commit message explicitly states this fixes two leaks: one when writing `"false"` while already manual, and one when writing `"true"` because the old state was overwritten by `rcu_assign_pointer()` but never freed.

It adds an early return when `old_wi_state` exists and `input` matches `old_wi_state->mode_auto`, and frees `new_wi_state` before returning. It also preserves the previous copy-forward behavior only when there is an existing state to copy from, while still allowing the update path to proceed when no old state exists.
